name: Mahra Sultanate
alt: Mahra State of Qishn and Socotra
Mahra Sultanate of Ghayda and Socotra

predecessors.name: Rasulid dynasty
predecessors.text: Shihr, taken by the Ba Dujana in 1432

successors.name: People's Democratic Republic of Yemen
successors.text: the Mahra region (Al Mahrah) and the island of Socotra

ledger.x: c. 1480: Mahri settle Socotra as a base against Hadhramaut. The sultanate traces itself to 1432, when the Ba Dujana took Shihr; after losing Shihr in 1495 the Afrar core around Qishn and Socotra consolidated.
1886: Protectorate Treaty with Britain places the sultanate under the Aden Protectorate; a similar treaty with Sultan Ali bin Abdulla followed in 1888.
1967: British withdrawal; the last sultan Isa bin Ali is deposed by the National Liberation Front.

certainty.note: The page names no boundaries; the modern governorate and Socotra are stand-ins.
